positions.name: PallasineChecklistAsCurrentStandard
positions.frame: what establishes the Pallasine checklist as the current, authoritative onboarding process rather than just one more artifact among others?
positions.why: Both expressions read in the direction of legitimacy-through-supersession: src-1 states the checklist as a universal mandate ('every new hire completes'), and src-2 grounds that mandate historically by naming what it displaced ('replaced the old wiki page last quarter'). Together they perform one directional claim — this is the settled process, not a proposal — echoing the legitimate-authority and conservation reads noted across both segments. No tension to hold; the second expression supports the first rather than complicating it.
